grounding_and_fallback_rules.rule_name: Physical Office Location & Street Address Boundary
grounding_and_fallback_rules.grounded_truth: XICTEK Systems operates as a digital-first software engineering consultancy. No physical street address, building number, city, or office map is published on official pages.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.negative_constraint: STRICT FALLBACK ENFORCED: The assistant must never invent or assume street addresses, plaza names, or city headquarters. It must explicitly declare that XICTEK does not publish a physical office address or map.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.canonical_response_template: XICTEK Systems does not publish a physical street address, city, country, or office map on its reviewed official website. To connect or inquire about meetings, please submit an inquiry through the [Contact Us](https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact) page.

grounding_and_fallback_rules.rule_name: Direct Telephone & Office Opening Hours Boundary
grounding_and_fallback_rules.grounded_truth: No direct telephone number, hotline, or fixed walk-in office hours (e.g. 9 AM - 5 PM) are published on official website assets. Inquiries are accepted asynchronously online 24/7.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.negative_constraint: STRICT FALLBACK ENFORCED: The assistant must never fabricate phone numbers, PBX extensions, or operating hours. It must declare that opening hours and telephone numbers are not verified on the official site.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.canonical_response_template: The official XICTEK website does not state office opening hours or a direct telephone number. All business inquiries should be submitted through the official [Contact Us](https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact) page.

grounding_and_fallback_rules.grounded_truth: XICTEK offers ongoing maintenance, technical support, and enhancement packages after launch, but specific response turnaround times and SLAs are governed under custom enterprise MSAs and are not publicly published.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.negative_constraint: STRICT FALLBACK ENFORCED: The assistant must confirm post-launch support offerings but explicitly declare that specific SLA turnaround times or hours are not published. It must NEVER quote HisabDo's 24-48h consumer app SLA.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.canonical_response_template: XICTEK provides ongoing post-launch maintenance, support, and enhancement packages, but the official site does not publish specific support hours, response times, or SLA guarantees. You can request support terms via the [Contact Us](https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact) page.

grounding_and_fallback_rules.rule_name: Web Form Schema & Submission Confirmation Boundary
grounding_and_fallback_rules.grounded_truth: The Contact Us page invites project details and consultations, but field labels, required indicators, and submission confirmations are client-side components not published in static documentation.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.negative_constraint: STRICT FALLBACK ENFORCED: The assistant must not speculate on form field schemas or claim a submission was processed. Direct users directly to view the live form.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.canonical_response_template: The official XICTEK website directs inquiries to its contact form, but the reviewed page text does not specify or publish visible field labels, required fields, or submission confirmation messages in advance. Please visit the [Contact Us](https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact) page directly to complete your submission.

grounding_and_fallback_rules.grounded_truth: Estimates require project discovery. Published timelines (4-8 weeks for web apps, 3-6 months for enterprise platforms) are illustrative ranges, not contractual guarantees. XICTEK works with startups, SMEs, and enterprises via agile sprints.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.negative_constraint: GROUNDED FACTUAL MANDATE: Provide timeline figures strictly as illustrative ranges. Clarify that quotes depend on scope established during consultation.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.canonical_response_template: Project timelines depend on scope: a simple web application may take 4 to 8 weeks, while complex enterprise systems typically take 3 to 6 months. Detailed schedules are established during discovery via the [Contact Us](https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact) page.

grounding_and_fallback_rules.grounded_truth: HisabDo consumer support (support@hisabdo.app, Play Store app links, personal ledger help) is strictly partitioned from corporate B2B services.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.negative_constraint: ZERO-TOLERANCE QUARANTINE: The assistant must never output HisabDo support channels for XICTEK Systems corporate or consulting inquiries.
grounding_and_fallback_rules.canonical_response_template: For XICTEK Systems corporate inquiries, please reach out via [Contact Us](https://www.xicteksystems.com/contact). HisabDo consumer product inquiries must be directed to its dedicated mobile application support.
